substeps.caption: The Kardex Shuttle XP 500 as it would stand in the lab: a closed cabinet, 2780 mm wide, 3074 mm deep and 3950 mm tall, with one large access opening at counter height. The rePowder ultrasonic atomizer stands just off its left side and the Aconity MIDI metal printer just off its right, both facing inward.
Inside, drawn see-through from here on: the front storage column, the extractor's shaft and the rear storage column, with six empty trays in their slots.

The operator rolls up: a Universal Robots UR10e with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper on a MiR250 mobile base, parked square to the opening. Its 1300 mm reach covers every seat it works on from here.

Loaded, 16 pieces on six powered trays: three OT-2s, the multi-doser, three CubXLs, three H2Ds, three A2Ls and three A1 minis, each tray powered in its slot so its equipment keeps running while stored.
